# LESSONS — financial-analyst (sleep-cycle output; created 2026-08-15)

1. **Audit the METHOD, not whether it runs.** The inherited template had no
   mortality weighting, and all-zero placeholder defaults meant every test
   passed while a required term was simply absent — a green gate over a hole
   (the ELEGANCE "gate that cannot see" class). Placeholder defaults hide
   missing terms as effectively as wrong ones. (journal 0002)
2. **Never infer a bias and apply it.** "I inferred a bias, applied x0.85,
   and was wrong" — retracted in place. A correction with no independent
   citable basis defaults to NULL (1.0), stated as such. (journal 0002)
3. **An inherited NOT-LOCATED is a lead, not a settled fact** — especially
   when the earlier run disclosed a capability constraint (exhausted search
   budget). Re-searching moved the headline +78%. The same misread class as
   gandalf 0300 (a budget HALT read as substrate-down). (journal 0002)
4. **Grounding is deterministic**: a delegated agent caught a fabricated
   quotation by grepping the source PDF. Every number in the report must
   match an evaluated graph node ([fa3]); every quote must grep. (journal 0002)
